subject.title: [Bug]: Potential resource leak in runBoundTurnWithMissingThreadRecovery -- retry not wrapped in try/finally after thread spawn

question: Should Codex app-server bound conversations retain a persistent thread subscription across turns, or should OpenClaw reattach before each turn and unsubscribe afterward?
rationale: The current source path supports the leak concern, but the safest fix shape depends on the intended ownership of a persisted bound thread after recovery writes the replacement binding.

options.title: Preserve persistent subscription
options.body: Treat the replacement thread as conversation-owned after the binding is written, then add focused tests or comments proving retry rejection leaves a usable next turn without orphaning unintended state.

options.title: Reattach and unsubscribe per turn
options.body: Change bound turns to explicitly reattach before each turn/start, unsubscribe afterward, and cover two consecutive bound turns plus retry rejection.

options.title: Clean only abandoned replacement threads
options.body: Only unsubscribe or clear the replacement thread when maintainers decide a retry rejection should discard the newly written binding.

recommendation.title: Preserve persistent subscription
recommendation.body: Treat the replacement thread as conversation-owned after the binding is written, then add focused tests or comments proving retry rejection leaves a usable next turn without orphaning unintended state.
